PLEASE try to get Ghislaine Maxwell to give information on the former Gov. of US
Virgin Islands, John DeJongh, who facilitated Jeffrey Epstein's construction and USE
of his private Little St James Island. And about his wife, Cecile DeJongh, who managed
Epstein's business front in St Thomas, VI for 20 years.

If we local inhabitants of St Thomas knew or thought we knew about what was going on,
how could politicians who signed permits, who were aware of how Jeffrey E entered and
left the STT Airport, though his own private exit, and WHO traveled with him, how
could our Senators not know?

Our island is small, people know everyone's business, people gossip. The first rumours
were started by local men who worked on the construction of the island mansion. Airport
handlers and employees were aware of Epstein's facilitated access. Nobody was blind
about his traveling companions.

Besides a good paycheck, what kind of business did Mrs. DeJongh actually oversee at
Jeffrey's STT Office front that would keep her on retainer for 20 years?

This is not a hate letter against the DeJonghs.. But it is about our corrupt, non-
functioning legislators who only know how to line their own pockets with Federal funds
that travel much further than overstaffed inept department employees whose only
professional qualifications are `extended family'.

We follow the Epstein and now Maxwell engin because we are hoping some hard truths
will come to light ,enough to scare current politicians from continuing the same old same
old and getting away with it. Tons of Federal monies come here, but they disappear on
the way to intended projects that never get done, just revised again and again by
`consultants'

We would also like to know who gave the order to the FBI to turn around mid-flight
when they were coming to arrest DeJongh? Was it a lobbyist? Was it a favor called in?
Or was it just gossip on a small island that spreads faster than our never-works phone
company and power-always-off utility company.

We'd like you to follow the money, as they say. (Oh, and they are 4 years behind
processing our 1040 and paying our refunds due).

Please help! Our `helpers & protectors" are too involved and too busy helping their own
selves first.

Please follow up your investigation of SOUTHERN TRUST Epstein's front in the VI.
Citizens here are tired of the shenanigans of our legislators. The Feds send lots of
money, make lots of junkets, and now we are even fair game for lobbyists. Although
we are citizens, and sons can be drafted, we are not allowed to vote for president. BUT
the GOP has been very interested in our nominating convention delegate votes.

There has an Economic Prejudice at work here since 70's...we are considered a Third
World-type area where it is known, and has been TRUE, that the local populace is not
well informed, the legislators are open to bribes, the payoffs for tricky investors huge.
Check out how the EDC here has grown, a complete freebie, for folks who already have
money and trust fund children who want to play at a job...going out of business makes
good tax sense and you can leave after your year or two of fun in the sun.

Airport maintenance, construction workers, anybody that gossips all let word spread
about what was going on at the `pedophile island" since the early days. Governor
deJongh's wife worked for Southern Trust while he had his finger in many other pies and
needless to say heads…
